customManagers.description: Track the digest-pinned Python images that the wheel-test steps run with `docker run`. The built-in docker manager does not scan shell `run:` commands, so without this the pins would never be refreshed.

packageRules.description: Refresh the real-world corpus submodules once a month, grouped into a single PR.
schedule: before 3am on the first day of the month

packageRules.description: The YAML test suite is the compliance baseline; bumping it can change which cases pass and needs expectations regenerated, so update it by hand rather than via Renovate.

Do not let Renovate pin or bump the setup-python python-version. The GitHub Actions runner images lag CPython patch releases, so pinning to the newest patch (e.g. 3.14.6) breaks setup-python until the runners catch up. Keep the major.minor spec (3.14) and manage supported versions by hand.
The oss-fuzz base image republishes its :latest digest daily, which otherwise opens a digest-bump PR every day. Refresh the fuzzing base image only once a month.
schedule: before 3am on the first day of the month
